[size=4][b]Devotion 1.0.4[/b][/size]

First public build since 1.0.2. Combines the unreleased 1.0.3 with further
fixes. [b]No new game required[/b] unless noted.

Thanks to [b]DrHeisen[/b], whose independent audit of 1.0.2 found a number of
the defects below.

[size=3][b]!! READ THIS IF YOU USE REQUIEM !![/b][/size]

Devotion now ships its own copy of [b]Scripts\TempleBlessingScript.pex[/b].
Requiem's bugfix packs ship the same file, so in Mod Organizer 2 [b]Devotion
must sit BELOW them[/b] (below = higher priority = wins). If Devotion loads
above them, the shrine bug below comes back and [b]nothing will warn you[/b].

To confirm: MO2 [b]Data[/b] tab, find [i]Scripts\TempleBlessingScript.pex[/i],
it should list [b]Devotion[/b] as the provider.

[size=3][b]Fixed - save damage[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Runaway stat drift (save-corrupting).[/b] 418 of Devotion's 422
value-modifier effects were missing the engine's Recover flag, so every time a
neglect, disfavor, pact-price or blessing effect switched on and off it baked
the change in permanently. Stats drifted further every cycle for the life of
the save - two users reported -22131% Magic Resistance and -5000 armour. All
value-modifier effects now revert cleanly.
[*][b]Curing an already-damaged save:[/b] use MCM > Devotion > Player >
Maintenance > [b]Check stat damage[/b] to see what your save is carrying, then
[b]Repair stats[/b] to clear it. Save first. Note it also clears permanent
modifiers other mods placed on those same values.
[*][b]Two observance effects still drifted[/b] on a second effect type the
first sweep missed.
[*][b]Devotion could stop working permanently[/b] after a single lost script
tick - dawn processing, pacts, the startup choice and the reconcile pass all
stopped for the rest of the playthrough with nothing in the log. A watchdog
now restarts it on load.
[*][b]Uninstalling left effects on your character[/b], including Malacath's
speed price, so an uninstalled long-pact Orc stayed permanently slower.
[/list]

[size=3][b]Fixed - shrines (Requiem users)[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Praying wiped every buff you were carrying and gave nothing back.[/b]
Requiem's bugfix packs add a line to the shrine script that dispels ALL your
active magic effects - potions, fortify effects, enchantments, standing-stone
powers. Normally invisible, because Requiem's blessing lands right after.
Devotion deliberately makes shrines grant no blessing (praying moves your
standing with a god and writes a Book of Days entry; it is not meant to hand
out stats from whatever overhaul you run), so all that was left was the loss.
Fixed - praying no longer dispels anything, and still awards piety.
[*][b]Not a Requiem user?[/b] You never had this. Base Skyrim's script does not
dispel. The only change for you is that two vanilla "blessing removed /
blessing received" pop-ups no longer appear - both described something
Devotion prevents anyway.
[/list]

[size=3][b]Fixed - gods reacting correctly[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Daedric pact prices and pool boons did nothing.[/b] Every pact's
Health/Magicka/Stamina price and pool boon was authored so the game undid it
instantly. They now correctly raise and lower your maximum pool, so pacts have
the cost and benefit they describe.
[*][b]Hermaeus Mora's Champion boon was mis-wired[/b] - doubled Magicka and no
Alteration. Now grants Alteration +20 and Fortify Magicka +20 as contracted.
[*][b]Disfavor stings and several neglect penalties were applying as bonuses[/b]
- 22 penalty effects were authored in a self-cancelling form the engine read as
a buff. They now subtract as their descriptions say.
[*][b]Azura's likes and dislikes never loaded[/b] - an internal name mismatch
meant twelve reaction rows and her whole per-race stance table were skipped, so
she could not react to anything you did.
[*][b]Killing a Thalmor who attacked you[/b] counted as an unprovoked killing.
[*][b]A menu that could not open silently broke the Bosmer Old Contract[/b] -
worst case, a forced reckoning severed the pact with no player input.
[/list]

[size=3][b]Added[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Bosmer Green Pact food.[/b] Eating meat now rewards a Wood Elf keeping
the old pact - 22 vanilla and DLC meats (beef, goat, horse, venison, mammoth,
horker, boar, ash hopper, chicken, rabbit, pheasant, raw and cooked). Eating
plants remains the violation, unchanged. The existing daily limit applies, so
it cannot be farmed.
[*][b]Requiem food support[/b] - Torn Flesh (Strange Meat without Food and
Beverages Redone) plus Requiem's skeever, fox, bear, mammoth, sabrecat and
troll meat, and Wrothgar Tartare. Distributed by keyword, so it does nothing
if you do not run Requiem.
[*][b]Check stat damage / Repair stats[/b] buttons - see above.
[/list]

[size=3][b]Improved[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Equipping an item is dramatically cheaper.[/b] Devotion was re-reading and
re-resolving its reaction data from scratch on every check, sixteen times per
equip - in a large load order, hundreds of engine lookups every time you
equipped anything. Now resolved once when the save loads.
[*][b]Every scored action costs far less.[/b] Each god now knows in advance
which events it can score, instead of all ~34 paying for the lookup.
[*][b]Text formatting no longer runs 44 passes over every line[/b] of every
toast, journal entry and panel string.
[*][b]No more Papyrus log line for every corpse.[/b]
[*][b]Larger, longer-lasting notifications on 1440p and 4K[/b], and the toast
box now sizes itself to the message instead of leaving dead space.
[*][b]Quieter background polling[/b] throughout.
[/list]
